verdict.rationale: The evidence supports Docker self-hosting: the pricing page says "Self-host with Docker for free" and offers deployment on your own infrastructure, and a community user pulls the official mintplexlabs/anythingllm image. Nothing shows the other targets the story names, or that any of them has its own maintained guide. Missing for 10: Docker Compose guide, Kubernetes/Helm chart or guide, small-VPS deployment guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, evidence that the guides are maintained, independent hands-on corroboration of each path.
